name: Manna
source:
He's a savant of the European headquarters, a militant faction responsible for the annihilation and assassination of resistance forces. Without being given any ties, he is always alone doing dirty work.

He doesn't believe in God at all, and the only person he worships is his senior savant, Uni. In pursuit of Yuni, who was transferred to the Far East Branch, he snuck onto the same ship and came to the Far East.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#manna]official website[/url]]
